title: A Court Could Pause Frontier AI
concept: Legal showdown: gavel/stamp opening, giant defendant lineup, injunction demand, risk evidence board, courtroom cliffhanger.
cta: Follow AI Tested for the AI court fight.

beats.narration: A court is being asked to hit pause on frontier AI.
beats.headline: HIT PAUSE
beats.sub: A JUDGE IS BEING ASKED TO INTERVENE

beats.narration: Four nonprofits are suing Anthropic, Google, Meta, OpenAI, and SpaceX.
beats.headline: FIVE GIANTS

beats.narration: They want an emergency injunction to stop next-gen models.
beats.headline: EMERGENCY INJUNCTION

beats.narration: Until companies can prove humans stay in control.
beats.headline: PROVE CONTROL

beats.narration: The complaint cites cyberattacks, rogue warnings, and catastrophic risk admissions.
beats.headline: THE EVIDENCE

beats.narration: The wild part? Some warnings came from the builders themselves.
beats.headline: FROM THE BUILDERS
beats.sub: The warnings didn’t only come from outsiders.

beats.narration: So now the question isn’t just can we build it. It’s should a court let it keep going?
beats.headline: SHOULD IT CONTINUE?
beats.sub: CAN WE BUILD IT VS. SHOULD WE PAUSE IT
